I'm not sure exactly what the issue this is trying to fix as I am writing this whil commuting back home. I will do a follow up edit once I am home with more information and maybe a more actionable feedback.

As it stand I think this will cause a regression/compatibility breakage. What this assumes is that the only case where you want to edit (in the sense of plugins) is when you unfold directly by clicking it. 

Unfortunately this not the case as unfolding state is remembered as such unselecting a node and reselecting it should edit the node. And there might be other cases similar where it was expected for it to be sited and is not with this code. 

This might be a problem for two reasons I think. 
First users might have a certain resource open and expect the associated editor to be opened but it is not and they would have to fold it and the unfold it.
Second this might also happen when switching from one resource to another when having it unfolded.

Edit : I am now home and have been able to test it out and it is worth then I expected and where previously I thought there might have been a way to patch this approach I now think this approach cannot work at all. 
The one thing tha makes me say this cannot work is that when the resource being edited is replaced by anything that triggers an update of the inspector. The inspector would show the new resource but the plugin editor would still show the old resource this can lead to really weird behaviour especially with duplicating resource as you might modify the old resource whil thinking you are modifying the new one.
Here are a few exemples of the problem I am talking about one with the tileset editor not showing and the other with the tileset editor not switching the resource it is editing. Of course it is not restricted to tileset but affect all plugins.


https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2e3644c7-c3ca-454d-8d96-fcef7f73e6f6


https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/26600a2f-9e5f-430d-ab89-3a537b880416



https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/65076f3b-44f6-4793-848f-4f8c90cf8d2b




To make this work, we would need to find all ways to call update_property and add the same code in all places but this would most likely not fix the problem as it would just deport it to somewher else. Hence I think the problem should be solved elsewhere.
I will take a look tommorow if there is a better place or a better solution on how to deal with this bug

Hey, thanks for your valuable feedback. You are completely right, this solution causes regression for re-selecting nodes and switching between already unfolded resources. I am currently working on an alternative and my plan is to decouple the 'open editor' logic from the mouse click by tying it directly to the sub-inspector's state lifecycle. I am also planning to refactor the plugin lookup into a cleaner helper to avoid building unnecessary arrays. I think this alternative looks promising, but I will take a bit of time to test it properly. I'll push the updated PR once I've verified everything works as expected.
